sections.title: V5 img2img sits on a different noise schedule
sections.lede: More latent signal → more noise to destroy it. Low-strength overwrite is expected, not a bug.
sections.body:
Community noticed V5 img2img overwrites more at low strength (~30%) than V4.5. mahouko gave the mechanism on nai-diffusion-discussion: the latents have more signal, so more noise is needed to destroy them — compositional changes therefore happen in a different region of the noise schedule. Stop treating 30% strength as a gentle V4.5-style nudge on V5. Expect stronger rewrite earlier, and budget strength / denoise accordingly when you want composition lock.

**Try this.** Same seed family, V5 Full, Euler/karras, guidance 5, 23–28 steps, QT on, rescale 0. Take a keeper base. A: img2img strength ~0.30 with a mild prompt edit. B: strength ~0.45–0.55 for the same edit. C: optional V4.5 compare at 0.30 if you still have access. Watch how early composition breaks on V5.

**CTA.** Guren: one A/B strength ladder on a fixed seed. Ivory: note Studio copy that still implies V5 img2img ≈ V4.5 at the same %. Do not invent PE() contract changes.

excerpts.speaker: mahouko
excerpts.text: the latents have more signal so more noise is needed to destroy them, so compositional changes happen at a different region of the noise schedule

sections.title: No good reason to use DPM 2S — and borders usually mean <28 steps
sections.lede: Do not same-step-count compare DPM 2S. Do not neg-emph your way out of sampling issues.
sections.body:
Ifrit reported DPM 2S on V5 still wack like 4.5 — outside borders, letterboxing, 2koma, anatomy. mahouko cut it clean: there is no good reason to use DPM 2S; it should not be compared to other samplers at the same step count; border artifacts probably mean you are under 28 steps; and you really should not use negative emphasis to "fix" sampling issues. Pick a sane sampler (Euler/karras family is the house default), give it enough steps, and stop stuffing UC with border/letterbox as a sampler bandage.

**Try this.** Same seed, V5 Full, guidance 5, QT on, rescale 0. Prompt that previously letterboxed. A: DPM 2S @ 23 steps. B: Euler/karras @ 23 steps. C: Euler/karras @ 28–32 steps. Count borders/letterbox/2koma — do not add neg-emph between A and C.

**CTA.** Guren: one three-way. Ivory: strip any Studio preset that ships DPM 2S as default. Chiyo: board only if product chrome still highlights DPM 2S.

sections.title: If it costs Anlas, it generally does not eat Opus usage
sections.lede: Exception: first unpaid image in a multi-image Opus free window. Official journal linked.
sections.body:
Aini dropped the official journal article on Opus usage limits. ght901 clarified the product rule: in general, if something costs Anlas it does not use the Opus usage limit. The current exception is multi-image gens inside the Opus free window — you do not pay Anlas for the first image, so that image still counts against usage. Enhance that already costs Anlas likewise skips the usage meter because you are paying Anlas already. Pair this with Monday's upscaler note (paid Anlas upscale ≠ usage). Stop treating Anlas spend and the Opus allotment as the same bucket.

Docs: https://journal.novelai.net/opus-usage-limit-explained/

**Try this.** On Opus: run one free single image (A). Then a paid Enhance / Anlas path (B). Then a multi-image free burst and note which frame ticks usage (C). Log Anlas vs usage separately — do not invent cost fields if the packet omits them.

**CTA.** Ivory: Studio meter copy should say Anlas≠usage. Guren: optional one free+one Anlas pair only if battery allows.

sections.title: Quality does not vary by time of day — GPU moves can break seed repro
sections.lede: Same seed at different hours proves quality. Maintenance/GPU reshuffles are the real caveat, not a productivity aura.
sections.body:
Room folklore still claims "AI is better at certain hours." ght901 shut it down: quality of output does not vary over time — generate the same image with the same seed at varying times of day and you will see it. Separately, staff have said reproducibility on the same seed can be affected by maintenance / GPU moves — that is the intended caveat, not a productivity aura. Debug seed drift as infrastructure, not as clock magic.

**Try this.** Same prompt, V5 Full, Euler/karras, guidance 5, 28 steps, QT on. Generate once now (A). Re-run the identical seed later today or tomorrow (B). If they match, time-of-day is dead. If they differ after a known maintenance window, log it as GPU/repro — do not invent a quality schedule.

**CTA.** Guren: one same-seed re-roll when convenient. Chiyo: only board if product wants a "seed may change after maintenance" tip chrome.

ElDimentio hit the classic clash: specify an art style in plain English (no artist tags) and the body follows, but the head stays very anime. shambibble's shortcut: put moeslop / anime artists in UC — face and especially eyes are the most core concepts on NovelAI anime tunes, so vetoing those artists can release the face toward the prose style. sections.title: V5 comic oneshot: panels in base, one character box per appearance
sections.lede: 👀 mug: same char ×5 = five boxes with page location. Panel-inside-char-prompt failed.
sections.body:
On nai-image-advice, 👀 mug sketched a V5 comic oneshot path: specify every panel and what is in it (preferably page position) in the base prompt, and put every character appearance in its own character prompt. Same character five times on the page means five character prompts, each with location. Two different characters in one panel means two boxes. Trying to make each character prompt describe a whole panel instead of a character failed. Prefer this over V4.5 comic-from-scratch inpaint when it works. Still ANECDOTE until repeats.

**Try this.** Same seed, V5 Full, Euler/karras, guidance 5, 28 steps, QT on, multi-character enabled. Base: `4koma, top-left panel: …, top-right panel: …, bottom-left: …, bottom-right: …` with page positions. Boxes: one box per appearance (`girl, brown hair, top-left panel, waving` × appearances). A: one box per appearance. B: one box per panel describing the whole panel. Compare panel layout vs identity bleed.

**CTA.** Guren: small 2×2 oneshot A/B. Ivory: Studio comic presets should not assume one box = one panel.

sections.title: Mask the joint travel path — leftover shadow forces the fill
sections.lede: ght901 + Kirari (unofficial room): mask wider than you think. Geometry + shadow.
sections.body:
Helping in unofficial nai-image-gen-discussion, ght901 showed why a narrow hand/arm mask fails: for the hand to reach hers in that pose the arm must travel through unmarked area — or you invent impossibly long arms. Kirari~n reinforced: often you must mask way more than you think because subtle details force a specific fill; a too-narrow shoulder mask blocks bending; and shadow under a limb is the bane of all inpainters — leftover shadow forces fill that preserves the shadow. Mask geometry of motion, not just the pixels you dislike. Room agreement ≠ STAFF; keep ANECDOTE until guide landing repeats.

**Try this.** Same seed, V5 Full, inpaint, strength moderate. Pose that needs a limb to move. A: tight mask on the hand only. B: wider mask covering shoulder→elbow→hand travel path + cast shadow. Same prompt. Compare whether the arm can actually reach.

**CTA.** Guren: one geometry A/B (Laboratory workspace). Ivory: Studio inpaint tips — "mask the path, not the pixel." Grim stills below are reference only; spicy stays off the billboard.

excerpts.speaker: ght901
excerpts.text: It isn't. For his hand to reach hers reasonably in that pose the arm needs to travel through an area you haven't marked. Or he'd have to have incredibly long arms. Here's a rough first attempt and the mask. I didn't change the prompt at all, it's what it imported as.

excerpts.speaker: Kirari~n ☆
excerpts.text: often you just have to mask way more than you think is necessary, because there are subtle details that force it to fill in a specific way. … the mask around his shoulder is so narrow that there's no way to bend his arm at the shoulder … the bane of all inpainters: shadow.

sections.body:
Laboratory only today — eight Try-this rungs, Opus/free first, one Anlas upscale, stop before burnout.

**Img2img noise (V5).** Keeper cafe base, then holding-coffee edit: strength ~0.30 barely moved the pose (no cup in hand); ~0.50 started overwriting composition early (ears, layout drift) while still refusing a clean held cup. Mild % on V5 is not V4.5 mild %.

**DPM 2S / steps / borders.** Hallway wide-shot full-body seed family: requested DPM 2S @23 but MCP metadata landed as Euler ancestral and the Euler@23 re-roll cached the same file. Euler@28 also clean — no letterbox, no 2koma. Borders not reproduced this pass; no negative-emphasis bandage between arms.

**Anlas ≠ usage.** Free single txt2img, then paid `upscale_image` with allow_paid. Both packets omitted Anlas/usage cost fields — logged what arrived (`upscaled:true`, ratio 2) and skipped the multi burst. Monday's Opus-gate note still stands.

**Seed repro (same session).** Identical prompt/seed/28-step Euler twice back-to-back → same filename and pixels. Time-of-day is dead for same session. Cross-day GPU check waits for tomorrow (ANECDOTE).

**UC anime artists vs face bleed.** Oil-painting western fantasy + silver-haired armor girl: light UC and UC+`ciloranko, artist:as109` both kept anime faces on painterly bodies. B shifted scene more; neither cleared the face. ANECDOTE only — not consensus.

**Comic oneshot boxes.** 4koma base with panel positions. One character box per appearance locked identity and layout cleanly; one box per panel (whole scene in the box) also laid out but with slight identity variance. Prefer appearance boxes. `char_captions` present in both metadatas.

**Inpaint mask wider.** Skipped — MCP generate cannot paint a mask without a bound Studio client and mask UI. Do not invent masks to burn battery.

**HOUSE MCP boxes.** Identity-in-base with empty characters → empty `char_captions`. Light base + one character prompt → `char_captions` stamped. Confirmed: generate_image applies boxes.

**Try this leftovers.** Re-roll seed 2026091631 tomorrow for GPU/repro. If Studio still ships DPM 2S as a default, strip it. Do not promote UC anime-artist face-bleed fix from one inconclusive A/B.

**CTA.** Ivory: Studio cohesion — V5 img2img % copy, DPM 2S defaults, Anlas≠usage meter language, generate_image boxes already apply. Chiyo: board product chrome only if DPM 2S or usage meter still misleads. Parent: digest JSON archives Monday.
